name: shell
description: Minimum Viable Browser shell built on Electron.

scripts.start:dev: cross-env DISABLE_WIN_KEY_BLOCK=true DISABLE_TOUCHPAD_BLOCK=true DISABLE_FOCUS_GUARD=true DISABLE_MONITOR_CHECK=true electron-forge start
scripts.start:dev-direct: cross-env DISABLE_WIN_KEY_BLOCK=true DISABLE_TOUCHPAD_BLOCK=true DISABLE_FOCUS_GUARD=true DISABLE_MONITOR_CHECK=true env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron ./index.js
scripts.start:no-winkey: cross-env DISABLE_WIN_KEY_BLOCK=true DISABLE_TOUCHPAD_BLOCK=true DISABLE_FOCUS_GUARD=true electron-forge start
scripts.start:no-winkey-direct: cross-env DISABLE_WIN_KEY_BLOCK=true DISABLE_TOUCHPAD_BLOCK=true DISABLE_FOCUS_GUARD=true env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron ./index.js
scripts.package:all: npm run package:peserta && npm run package:penguji
scripts.make:universal: npm run make:x64 && npm run make:arm64
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Skipping native addon rebuild - using pre-compiled keyhook-helper.exe'

author: Samuel Maddock <sam@samuelmaddock.com>
